context.stage: WF-03 Issue Resolving — SPT-01 onboarding schema provisioning gap

task.description:
Root cause: The onboarding saga in `src/identity/onboarding.zig` (`executeSaga()`) creates a tenant row in `public.tenant` and provisions Keycloak, but never calls `provisionTenantSchema()` from `src/db/provisioning.zig`. As a result, every tenant registered via the API has a DB row in `public.tenant` but no PostgreSQL schema in `public.tenant_schemas` and no physical schema on disk.

This violates SPT-01 which requires that every successfully onboarded tenant has an isolated PostgreSQL schema provisioned immediately after the tenant record is created.

Evidence from live bpm_dev DB:
  - public.tenant: 2 rows (default, swiftroute)
  - public.tenant_schemas: 0 rows
  - information_schema.schemata: no tenant_% schemas

Fix required (BACKEND-DEV will implement per step 03):
1. In `executeSaga()`, immediately after `createTenantInDb()` succeeds, call `db_provisioning.provisionTenantSchema(allocator, pool, tenant.tenant_id)`. Add this step to saga compensation (drop schema row if subsequent steps fail).
2. Also provision `tenant_default` schema at server startup or via a one-time migration for the all-zeros default tenant if not already provisioned. Check `bpm_provision_tenant_schema()` — it is idempotent, so calling it at startup for the default tenant is safe.
3. Provide a one-shot SQL script (or `zig build migrate` step) to retroactively provision schemas for existing tenants that predate the fix.

Required files to read before designing:
  - src/identity/onboarding.zig (executeSaga function, SagaState struct, compensate function)
  - src/db/provisioning.zig (provisionTenantSchema signature)
  - src/db/pool.zig (schemaNameForTenant)
  - src/main.zig (startup sequence)

Create the ISS file at docs/issues/ and index it in docs/issues/issue_index.json.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause documented in ISS file
Design plan produced for BACKEND-DEV step 03

result.summary: ISS-0068 registered. Root cause confirmed: executeSaga() in src/identity/onboarding.zig creates public.tenant row but never calls provisionTenantSchema(). SagaState has no schema_provisioned flag and compensate() has no schema teardown. Design plan documented in docs/issues/ISS-0068.json covering three changes: (1) insert provisionTenantSchema call between steps 1 and 2 in executeSaga with compensation, (2) startup-time provision for default tenant, (3) retroactive migration for pre-fix tenants.
